column4: cleat#3545: these tests build their shards from real PostgreSQL databases (newRealShards -> bootstrapScratchDB), and sharding is a PostgreSQL configuration -- no sharded MySQL/SQL Server topology exists (same reason as cleat#2195's sharded-heartbeat-pool-sees-real-claimed-runs.tsv). They skip as bare test names, not a /postgres suffix, so the broad /postgres$ lines do not match them. Nine skips: seven top-level tests plus the two history_on_the_* subtests of TestAPurgeRefusedByAnyShardWritesNothingAnywhere (its parent passes). multi-db/mysql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so they skip here.

cleat#3545: same nine tests, same reason as the multi-db/mysql line above -- multi-db/mssql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL. They run, and pass, under test-go/engine and cluster, which set the PostgreSQL DSN, so no pairing is needed there.
